title: Understanding Residuals
text: When you perform linear regression, the residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. Think about what happens to these differences when you have a good fit.

title: Mean of Residuals
text: Consider the properties of the residuals in a linear regression model. What does it mean for the model to be unbiased? How does this relate to the mean of the residuals?
